column1: # p375 — ACTION p374-J limb 1: THE 756 BARE-ONLY ADDRESSES, GRADED FIRST-HAND.
# Measured 2026-10-22 over the nine SHELF_FILES of the tree this pass commits.
# WHY.  p374 found that the published address census reads ONE address channel of TWO:
# p351's census imports p348's harvester, whose pattern requires the literal `github.com/`
# prefix, so a bare backticked `owner/repo` is invisible -- counted neither as an address nor
# as a reject.  Channel U 2 687, p367's channel B 3 039, 756 visible only to B.  p374
# published the DISAGREEMENT and REFUSED to publish a corrected total, naming `admin-api/v1`
# from its own sample as a shape-valid non-address.  Grading the 756 was ACTION p374-J.
# HOW, and every probe is first-hand.  Two passes over the same 756:
#   1. p367's OWN prober (probe_slugs.sh adjudicate, reused not rewritten) -> LIVE / NO-REF
#   2. p375's rc probe on the NO-REF remainder -> ABSENT / LIVE-EMPTY, by RETURN CODE
# Pass 2 exists because p372 established that `NO-REF` CONFLATES three things: not a
# repository, deleted-or-private, and LIVE BUT COMMITLESS (rc=0 with an empty ref
# advertisement).  Collapsing them is how two prior passes called a live repository GONE.
# THE RESULT: 452 LIVE + 1 LIVE-COMMITLESS = 453 real addresses; 303 do not answer, every
# one rc=128.  Of those 303: 26 are graded NON-ADDRESSES BY SHAPE and 21 are this base's own
# planted negative controls, leaving 256 addresses that simply do not answer -- which is
# p372's dead-citation question and NOT this instrument's to settle.
# 🔴 THE TWO FALSE-POSITIVE CLASSES ARE BOTH ONE-SIDED ARMS IN STANDING INSTRUMENTS:
#   NAME-REF-OR-PATH  p367's arm 1 rejects a ref-or-path word in the OWNER position
#                     (`main/license` is its own control 5) and never tests the NAME
#   NAME-DOT-RUN      p351's NAME_RESERVED holds {".", ".."} while NAME_SHAPE admits dots,
#                     so a name of THREE dots was accepted.  p351 already rejects the OWNER
#                     form of exactly this as OWNER-ELLIDED; the name form was unguarded.
# 🔴 AND THE BLANKET FIX IS REFUTED BY THIS MEASUREMENT.  Rejecting all of p367's
# REF_OR_PATH vocabulary in the name position would have eaten TWO LIVE REPOSITORIES --
# `mattpocock/skills` and `vercel-labs/skills`, both answering a HEAD read in this file.
# So NAME_NOT_A_REPO holds only words measured 0 LIVE in the name position across all 756,
# `skills` is pinned as a negative control, and test control 12 re-reads THIS FILE to fail
# if a later edit ever adds a word with a live instance.
# 🔵 WHAT THIS FILE DOES NOT CLAIM.  ABSENT is not "never was an address".  256 of these are
# plausible addresses that do not answer today, and several are a named prior finding:
# `1edtech/badgr-server` (cited 12 times, the address p372's "ten of ten unretrievable"
# 🔴 Nine `imsglobal/*` addresses are in the absent set and IMS Global renamed to 1EdTech,
# so that cluster is a RENAMED ORG, not a vanished project -- stated as a reading, not graded.
